fusions.name: Sailor's Mermaid
fusions.desc: Lures up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Ambush
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a strike from where you lay still that deals 20 damage plus 1.5 times what your afflictions on it have left to deal, using them up.

fusions.name: Sunken Pretence
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and you regain 10 health at once. You move 10% faster while veiled, enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shrugged Back
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 25% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.
